name: upgrowth-growth-toolkit
description: 28 free read-only growth marketing tools: CAC, ROAS, PPC, schema, meta tags, robots.txt and AI crawler checks.

interface.longDescription: 28 read-only tools for growth marketing work, built by upGrowth Digital, a growth consultancy in Pune, India. Unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback), ROAS and break-even ROAS, ad budget planning, PPC forecasts, Amazon ACoS, campaign ROI, break-even, CLV and MDR charges; period growth, CAGR, YoY, YTD and projections; AI crawler access checks, AI-aware robots.txt, schema.org JSON-LD, meta tags, content SEO checks and SEO ROI; YouTube and Instagram earnings, engagement rate and website ad revenue; and documented 2026 growth moves by Indian companies with source links. Nothing is stored or logged.
interface.defaultPrompt: My CAC is Rs 2,000 and LTV is Rs 9,000. What's my LTV:CAC ratio and payback?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 28 read-only growth marketing tools (unit economics, ROAS, PPC forecasts, ACoS, schema.org JSON-LD, meta tags, robots.txt and AI crawler checks). No sign-up, nothing stored.

positive.prompt: My CAC is Rs 2,000 from Rs 2,00,000 spend and 100 new customers. ARPU is Rs 1,000 a month, gross margin 75% and monthly churn 5%. What are my LTV, LTV:CAC and payback?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls unit_economics and reports CAC Rs 2,000, LTV Rs 15,000, LTV:CAC 7.5 and payback about 2.7 months.

positive.prompt: I spent Rs 50,000 on Meta ads and made Rs 2,10,000 revenue at 40% gross margin. Am I above break-even ROAS?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls roas_check and reports ROAS 4.2 against break-even ROAS 2.5, so the campaign is above break-even with Rs 34,000 gross profit after ad spend.

positive.prompt: Is GPTBot or ClaudeBot blocked on upgrowth.in?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ai_crawler_access_check for upgrowth.in and lists each AI crawler as allowed, restricted or blocked based on the site's public robots.txt.

positive.prompt: Generate FAQ schema for two questions: 'Is the toolkit free?' (Yes) and 'Do I need an account?' (No).
positive.expected_behavior: Calls schema_generator with schema_type faq and returns valid FAQPage JSON-LD with both questions and answers.

positive.prompt: Forecast a Rs 1,00,000 monthly Google Ads budget at Rs 25 CPC, 3% conversion rate, Rs 2,000 per conversion and 50% margin.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ppc_forecast and reports 4,000 clicks, 120 conversions, CPA about Rs 833, revenue Rs 2,40,000, ROAS 2.4 and Rs 20,000 profit after ads.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Pune to Dubai next Friday.
What's the weather in Mumbai today?
Send an email to my team saying the campaign is live.
